content.short: Blockademia is a document-verification platform for publishing and checking credentials on Cardano.
content.description: Blockademia is a decentralized system for publishing and verifying documents with blockchain-based proof. The project is aimed at use cases such as certificates, diplomas, and other records where forgery or tampering creates real operational risk. Its ACI token powers publishing, incentives, rewards, and payments inside the system, while the core product centers on issuing documents to Cardano so they can be verified without being edited or deleted afterward.
content.meta: Find out about Blockademia (ACI) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
